remarks: The Key To Your Luxury Dream Home with Resort Living is here @ this Patrick Homes built masterpiece! Experience exceptional luxury, craftsmanship & resort-style living in this extraordinary 4/5 bedroom, 4.5 bath estate offering 4,926 sqft on the 1st & 2nd floors plus 1,600 sqft of finished lower level for over 6,500 sqft of *measured living space!Stunning curb appeal showcases a full stone front, covered entry, extended concrete driveway, heated 3-car side-load garage & professional landscaping. Inside, a grand 2-story foyer welcomes you with gleaming Brazilian cherry hardwoods, elegant chandelier, 10’ first-floor ceilings & extensive custom millwork. A bright home office with French doors is perfect for anyone working from home. Combo front Living rm & Dining rm lead to back Sunroom & Kitchen. Open Concept Chef’s Dream kitchen features white cabinetry, granite counters, tile backsplash, SS appliances, Dbl ovens, walk-in pantry & oversized island. The spectacular 2-story great room features soaring windows, gas fireplace & back staircase. An added sunroom offers additional living space overlooking the backyard oasis! Upstairs offers 4 spacious bedrooms, 3 full baths & convenient laundry. The luxurious primary suite features a gas fireplace, custom ceiling, spa bath w/whirlpool tub, walk-in shower & extraordinary dbl walk-in closet. 2 baths recently updated w/ new vanities & Toto toilets.The lower level is ONE OF A KIND! An entertainer’s paradise featuring a custom full-service bar with illuminated countertops, premium cabinetry, dishwasher & double walk-in wine cellar! Expansive lounge, gaming area & optional 5th bedroom/fitness room with adjacent office or closet. Indulge in your private GLAM SPA featuring a 4-5 person steam room, tiled walk-in shower & 6-person sauna! Heated floors & imported Italian doors elevate this incredible space.Step outside to your private resort featuring a covered outdoor entertaining area, stamped concrete patio, heated saltwater pool w/beach entry, built-in spa, mature landscaping & fully fenced yard. An exceptional luxury lifestyle inside & out!Some rooms have been staged for design & layout. A Must See to Appreciate!
